title: US Math Scores Fell To 270
hook: The weakest students lost 14 math points, widening the gap.
closing: Falling math scores compound over time, making early recovery matter.
question: What would help students recover?

segments.say: Math scores fell to 271. Decades of progress nearly vanished.
The weakest students lost 14 points. The setback hit those already furthest behind.
Math scores slipped again to 270. The expected rebound still has not arrived.
